$comment: Generated by gen-ts-vectors.ts (ts) or `cargo run --bin gen` (snow) in web/spikes/s-04-noise. Never edit by hand. All keys are obviously fake (bytes repeating one value). Byte strings are {hex} or {fill, length}. cases[]: a full IK handshake (2 messages with payloads) then transport steps. transport[]: {from, plaintext, ciphertext} where the sender encrypts with its send CipherState (nonce counts per direction) and the receiver must decrypt to the plaintext; or {rekey: direction} which rekeys that direction's CipherState on both sides. negative[]: message1 must be rejected by the responder (it fails reading message 1).
